Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Controller.Server

Class GamesManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Controller.Server.GamesManager
public class GamesManager extends Object
The GamesManager class is responsible for managing all active games on the server. It provides methods to add, remove, and retrieve game controllers, as well as to notify clients about active games and handle game interruptions.
